Container.Name: Secret
Container.Overview:
Share a password, a note or files through a link that opens once. Everything is encrypted in the browser, and the key stays in the link's fragment, so the server never sees the content.
Burn after reading or after a set number of reads, expiry from 5 minutes to 30 days, an optional password (Argon2id), up to 10 files per note, Markdown, QR codes and 10 languages. No accounts, no analytics, and no content, keys or IP addresses in the logs.
The data folder holds the database, the encrypted files and the server's encryption key, generated on the first start: back it up whole.
Container.Requires: The app runs as uid 1001. Before the first start, give it the data folder from the Unraid terminal: mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/secret && chown -R 1001:1001 /mnt/user/appdata/secret

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: The port of the web app and the API.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, encrypted files and the server's key. Must be owned by uid 1001 (see Requires).

Config.Name: Public address
Config.Description: The address visitors use, such as https://secret.example.com. Empty: http://localhost:3000.

Config.Name: App name
Config.Description: The name shown in the pages.

Config.Name: Client address header
Config.Description: Behind a reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik), set X-Forwarded-For so rate limits tell visitors apart. Empty when the app is reached directly.

Config.Name: Proxies in front
Config.Description: With ADDRESS_HEADER: how many proxies sit in front of the app (1 for a single reverse proxy, 2 if Cloudflare fronts it).

Config.Name: Server encryption key
Config.Description: Empty: generated on the first start and saved in the data folder. To keep it out of the folder and its backups, set 32 random bytes in base64 (openssl rand -base64 32). Never change it once notes exist.

Config.Name: Storage quota
Config.Description: The most bytes notes may take on disk, 0 for no limit.
